race.comment: Return of the 955m series. Always tough races but SHARING MOMENTS (7) is interesting first up off a long break. She's a lightly raced mare who only had one run last time in but did win one of these races very well as a $19 chance. Damian Lane is booked for the Scott Cameron yard and the pair go very well together. CATWALK ICON (6) resumes. She won two in a row to start last campaign, albeit they were over 1200m. She measured up to better races, the niggle is how sharp she is over this trip. MAGNABELLE ROYALE (4) resumes. She was a dominant winner here over 1000m first up last campaign and is 2/2 fresh. She's speedy and should give a huge sight. FARCITED (1) next best.
